data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: each canon entry carries a hard_constraint boolean (true for errors/validation/legal disclosures; false otherwise)
- dd-5: each canon entry carries a single documented semantic for hard_constraint (true means errors/validation/legal disclosures and any rule_ids citation makes the owning item immutable to coordination-pass mutation), and consumers can rely on this semantic identically
- dd-6: unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Description
Three coordinated edits:

1. plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_schema.yaml — flat-list additions only (no type annotations): (a) add 'hard_constraint' as a plain string entry to the optional_fields list; (b) add 'canon' as a plain string entry to the tag_vocabulary.domain list.
2. plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py — add '_overview.yaml' to the _SKIP_NAMES set at line 129 so per-namespace overview files are not validated as corpus entries.
3. plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py — add '_overview.yaml' to the SKIP_NAMES frozenset at line 53 so overview files are not indexed by BM25.
4. plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ui-reference-corpus-schema.md — create with the verbatim immutability semantic: "hard_constraint=true means the entry governs errors/validation/legal disclosures; any rule_ids citation referencing such an entry makes the owning item immutable to coordination-pass mutation."

The .sh wrappers (check-corpus-schema.sh, ref-query.sh) are thin pass-throughs and require no change for this task.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a fixture canon YAML (domain: canon, hard_constraint: true) and a sibling _overview.yaml; When the test invokes check-corpus-schema.py directly against the fixture directory; Then BEFORE the edits, the run errors with 'Unknown field hard_constraint' or 'unknown domain canon' (RED); AFTER the edits, the canon YAML validates clean, _overview.yaml is skipped, AND a regression fixture exercising pre-existing components/copy/voice domains continues to validate clean.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] _schema.yaml has hard_constraint in optional_fields and canon in tag_vocabulary.domain
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; s=yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_schema.yaml')); assert 'hard_constraint' in s['optional_fields']; assert 'canon' in s['tag_vocabulary']['domain']"
- [ ] check-corpus-schema.py _SKIP_NAMES includes _overview.yaml
  Verify: grep -E "'_overview\\.yaml'|\"_overview\\.yaml\"" plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py
- [ ] ref-query.py SKIP_NAMES includes _overview.yaml
  Verify: grep -E "'_overview\\.yaml'|\"_overview\\.yaml\"" plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py
- [ ] Immutability semantic documented verbatim
  Verify: grep -q 'immutable to coordination-pass mutation' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ui-reference-corpus-schema.md
- [ ] Backward-compat regression: existing non-canon YAMLs validate
  Verify: python3 plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/
- [ ] RED-then-GREEN behavioral test passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-corpus-schema-canon.sh
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-corpus-schema-canon.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_schema.yaml | Edit |
| plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py | Edit |
| plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py | Edit |
| plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ui-reference-corpus-schema.md | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/test-corpus-schema-canon.sh | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/.test-index | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Extend ui-reference schema + skip _overview.yaml in check-corpus-schema.py and ref-query.py
